title: Popover
summary: The popover object displays a small text bubble for any element using the `data-popover` attribute.

description.main: Use the popover object to provide short, supporting information on click or keyboard focus. The popover is applied automatically through the `[data-popover]` selector, so no extra class is required. For non-interactive elements, add `tabindex="0"` if the popover should also be reachable by keyboard.

attributes.data-popover: The text content shown inside the popover bubble.
attributes.tabindex: Optional. Add `0` on non-interactive elements to allow keyboard focus and reveal the tooltip on focus.

description.heading: Basic popover
description.description: A simple inline element with popover text revealed on click.
